scripts.title: Role ESP, Auto Disguise, NO EMP
scripts.features:
Mafia & Role ESP
See everyone through walls. The script automatically tracks game events to instantly expose who the hidden Mafia and Saboteurs are, alongside showing everyone's disguise names, real usernames, and distance.

Auto-Pick Disguise
Got a favorite disguise? The script will instantly snipe and claim it for you the exact millisecond the selection screen opens, beating everyone else to it.

Teleport & Bring Players
Take complete control of the map. Instantly teleport directly to any player, forcibly pull targets right to your feet, or use point-and-click teleporting to zip exactly to where you're looking.

Walk Speed & NoClip
Become completely untouchable. Outrun anyone with customizable speed, and phase straight through walls, floors, or locked doors to easily escape danger or set up an ambush.

Force Third Person
Bypass the game's forced camera lock. Play in a full third-person view so you can always watch your back and effortlessly peek around corners without exposing yourself.

Fullbright & EMP Remover
Never get caught in the dark or blinded. Instantly remove pitch-black shadows and completely clear away EMP screen effects so your vision is always crystal clear.
